title: IncidentAlertEvent
description: Translated event for the alert intake — a managed incident with lifecycle, owner, acknowledgment, and a contractual deadline. Published on the translated topic; every business consumer downstream of translation reads this, never the raw envelope. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#incident and docs/insights/fluxo-do-incidente.md.

event_id.description: Same identifier as the raw envelope this event was translated from.

version.description: Version of this translated contract — separate from dictionary_version, since the two change for different reasons.

dictionary_version.description: Version of the source's translation dictionary that produced this line. See domain/acl/itsm.md#o-dicionário-de-tradução.

external_id.description: Identity in the origin, e.g. a ticket number.

acknowledged_at.description: Only when the origin has the field. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#acknowledgment.

closed_at.description: Only when the origin has the field.

status.description: Lifecycle only, translated by the origin's dictionary. Acknowledgment is a separate axis (acknowledged_at); a business verdict like no_intervention lives in resolution_code, never here.

resolution_code.description: Origin's own vocabulary for how the incident ended — e.g. the ITSM's 'Sem Intervenção'. Translated by the dictionary; drives is_eligible downstream, in silver. See domain/ubiquitous-language.md#no_intervention.
